summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 15, 2026 press release announcing completion of the first installation phase of its Driver Distraction Prevention System across Cemex Germany's truck fleet, following 2025 passenger-car deployments. No securities, ownership, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed; the item is a commercial customer-expansion update. The filing is incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. What to watch: execution risk on the planned full-fleet and multi-region rollout, and any revenue contribution disclosed in subsequent periodic reports.
